examples.label: Documentation header with search
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="extra_large" font_weight="font-semibold">Documentation <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" class="block mt-1 text-gray-500">Guides, recipes and the full component reference.
<.component component_name="chelekom-search-field" site="Global" id="docs-search" name="q" value="" label="Search the docs" floating="outer" space="small" search_button class="w-full sm:w-80" />

examples.label: Help center hero with popular topics
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="double_large" font_weight="font-semibold">How can we help? <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" class="mt-2 text-gray-500">Search more than 400 articles, or start from a popular topic.
<.component component_name="chelekom-search-field" site="Global" id="help-center-search" name="query" value="" label="Search articles" description="Try billing, single sign-on, or exporting data" description_class="text-[12px] text-gray-500 mb-1" floating="outer" space="small" search_button />
<.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="medium" rounded="full">Billing <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="medium" rounded="full">Single sign-on <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="medium" rounded="full">Exporting data <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="medium" rounded="full">API keys
